//ignoreCommand: Skips the build when the last commit changed nothing inside client/. This project shares a repository with the NestJS server, and without this every server-only commit would rebuild and redeploy an identical site. Exit 0 means skip; a non-zero exit (files did change) means build. Vercel's Root Directory setting must be set to `client` for the `.` here to mean the client folder.

rewrites.comment: Every path serves index.html so React Router can resolve it in the browser. Without this, opening /dashboard directly — or refreshing while on it — returns a 404, because Vercel looks for a dashboard/index.html that a single-page build never produces. Real files are matched first, so hashed assets under /assets are unaffected.

headers.comment: Vite puts a content hash in every asset filename, so a given URL can never change. Caching them for a year costs nothing and a deploy invalidates them by producing new names.
index.html must never be cached: it is the file that points at the hashed assets, so a stale copy would keep serving the previous deploy's JavaScript.
